reason: Official Open Bandit Pipeline executable documentation resolves two source-schema assumptions before any empirical policy-value result is produced.

position.v0_1: position = 1 was described as the leftmost recommendation position
position.v0_2: The primary position is the leftmost recommendation slot, defined as the minimum raw OBD position label and normalized to internal position 0.
position.basis: OpenBanditDataset applies dense rank to raw position and subtracts one; therefore its internal position indexing begins at zero.

action_count.v0_2: No fixed action count is assumed prospectively. The official source audit must derive the action universe from the all-campaign data and item context before OPE runs.
action_count.basis: OpenBanditDataset defines n_actions from the observed action IDs rather than a hard-coded campaign constant.

propensity_field.v0_2: propensity_score remains the primary executable field. A legacy action_prob alias may be detected and reported but must not be silently substituted when both or neither are present.
propensity_field.basis: Current OpenBanditDataset loader reads propensity_score into pscore.

unchanged: random reference restricted to the BTS evaluation time window
outcome_visibility: No Open Bandit Dataset CTR, reward mean, OPE estimate, challenger value, ranking, or promotion result was inspected to make this amendment.
